newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gasoline retail price rises to 106 yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan gasoline retail price rises to 106 yen.

text.p: The average retail price of gasoline at petrol stations throughout Japan was 106 yen per litre as of December 10, up one yen from a month earlier, a research centre said on Wednesday.
The month-on-month increase, shown in a survey taken by the Oil Information Service Centre, was the first since October 1992, an official with the centre said.
Refiners have recently been raising wholesale prices of their oil products to reflect sharply higher global crude prices and the yen's weakness against the dollar.
However, the retail price of gasoline did not go up because of competition among gasoline stations and opposition from consumers.
The national average retail price of gas oil, mainly used as fuel in trucks and buses, was 83 yen per litre, also up one yen from a month earlier.
It represented the second consecutive month-on-month rise.
